in_marathi.name: Keerthansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Keerthansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Keerthansh is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Keertha’ which means victory and ‘Ansh’ which means form or manifestation. This name is given to a child who is believed to bring victory and triumph in his life.
